name: asking for coordinates and instructions
gloss: Members ask where and how to place: coordinates, instructions, what to do with their pixel.
must_show: Requests for directions: where the work is, which coordinates, what to do, whether one is placing correctly; a pixel offered with a request to be told where to put it.
must_not_show: Coordinates, templates or how-to given (T3-070); asking what r/place is (T3-016).
decide_when_both: Questions and answers in one theme: the side with more concepts is primary, the other added under rule 0 when it has three or more.

discriminators.question: Are directions asked for (T3-034) or given (T3-070)?
Is the question how and where to place for the room (T3-034), or what r/place is (T3-016)?

varies: From a newcomer asking how to join to a member demanding specific instructions before the room will act.
is_not: Explaining what r/place is to members who have not seen it (T3-016).
two_or_half: It is half of T3-070, the question its answers meet; kept apart because many rooms asked and no one answered.

exemplars.quote: Where? So the rest of us can help
bir pikselim var milletime armağan olsun, söyleyin nereye koyayım?
How does one join the whole placing tiles?

name: putting decisions to a vote
old_label: putting a decision to the room
gloss: A choice about the work is put to the room: a vote, a strawpoll, a call to decide together.
must_show: Members asked to decide together: votes, strawpolls and polls in the thread, 'we need to decide as a group', a leader letting the room choose; members casting votes.
must_not_show: The design settled by argument with no vote (T3-004); a chat's decision reported (T3-152); office-holders elected (T3-173).
decide_when_both: A design argument that ends in a vote: T3-004 primary when the arguing leads, T3-066 added when the vote has concepts of its own.

discriminators.question: Is the design argued out (T3-004), or put to a vote or poll (T3-066)?
Is the decision taken by the room in the thread (T3-066), or reported from a chat (T3-152)?
Is a choice about the work voted (T3-066), or a person elected to an office (T3-173)?
Does the room decide (T3-066), or is one member put in charge (T3-101)?

varies: From a strawpoll between two backgrounds to an extended vote on what to paint next; leaders deferring to polls.
is_not: A faction holding elections for its offices (T3-173).
two_or_half: It is half of T3-004 when the choice is a design; kept apart because the way of deciding, a vote, is what a reader sees.

exemplars.quote: We need to agree on one of these guys [Created a strawpoll](http://www.strawpoll.me/12664825)
Ok guys we need to decide as a group whether or not we fix this
VOTEN YA! VOTACIÓN EXTENDIDA HASTA LAS 17:30. LO QUE GANE SERA PINTADO AL SUR DE URUGUAY!

name: sharing coordinates, templates and how-to
gloss: Members circulate what placers need to reproduce the work: coordinates, templates, grids, guides, colour, border and timing plans, and how-to.
must_show: Coordinates, templates, grid images, overlays, guides, colour plans, border plans, timings or how-to posted or updated for placers to follow by hand.
must_not_show: Insisting that the room use one template against rival versions (T3-091); scripts that place automatically (T3-028); asking for coordinates (T3-034).
decide_when_both: A call to place that carries coordinates: T3-070 when the directions lead, T3-002 when the call does; both with concepts of their own, rule 0.

discriminators.question: Are directions shared for anyone to use (T3-070), or the room held to one official plan against others (T3-091)?
Is the doing the directions (T3-070), or the call for hands (T3-002)?
Is a picture or coordinates given for people to place by hand (T3-070), or a script that places (T3-028)?
Is the design still argued (T3-004), or its directions handed out (T3-070)?
Is the event explained for anyone (T3-016), or a guide, template or coordinates for the room's work posted to follow (T3-070)?
Are directions asked for (T3-034) or given (T3-070)?
Are directions given to all (T3-070), or parts handed to particular members (T3-103)?

varies: From one pair of coordinates to step-by-step guides and colour-coordination threads; plans of colours, borders and timings are included.
is_not: Arguing over which design to build (T3-004).
two_or_half: It could split into coordinates and templates, which would be splitting by tool; with T3-091 it is half of directing placers, kept apart because insisting on one plan is another act.

exemplars.quote: Update: Here is the guide: http://i.imgur.com/kAzcjIv.jpg
The grid layout of our flag!
Coords are (159,721) if anyone needs them

name: keeping everyone on one template
old_label: putting the room on one template
gloss: Members hold the room to one official design or plan, against versions and placers that stray.
must_show: One plan declared official or current and members told to follow it: 'stick to the original', 'too many people do not follow the plan', an official design thread.
must_not_show: Coordinates or templates shared with no insistence on one (T3-070); choosing which design (T3-004).
decide_when_both: Choosing the design is T3-004; once it is chosen, keeping placers to it is T3-091.

discriminators.question: Are directions shared for use (T3-070), or one plan imposed against others (T3-091)?
Is the design being chosen (T3-004), or the chosen design enforced (T3-091)?
Is the scattering complained of (T3-049), or one plan imposed as its remedy (T3-091)?
Are the room's pieces narrowed to fewer (T3-069), or placers held to one design of one piece (T3-091)?
Are hand placers held to the current plan (T3-091), or scripts brought into line with it (T3-089)?
Is everyone held to one plan (T3-091), or the plan cut into assigned parts (T3-103)?

varies: From one plea to keep the lettering to official coordination threads with updated plans.
is_not: A member posting the latest template with no word on following it (T3-070).
two_or_half: See T3-070: half of directing placers, kept apart by the insistence on one plan.

exemplars.quote: For the love of god stick to the original lettering on the "Go Green".
Inderdaad, er zijn te veel mensen die het plan niet volgen.
Official Design thread

name: putting one member in charge
gloss: The room puts one member, or a few, in charge of the work, or members ask for someone in charge.
must_show: A leader named, claimed, appointed or asked for: someone in charge of the work, project leads through whom decisions go, overseers or ministers appointed, a temporary leader.
must_not_show: Votes on the work (T3-066); a faction's elections for its offices (T3-173); disputes over who speaks for the room to others (T3-126).
decide_when_both: A leader appointed and then elected in form: T3-173 when the election is the doing, T3-101 when the leading is.

discriminators.question: Does the room decide by vote (T3-066), or does one member lead (T3-101)?
Is a leader for the work named (T3-101), or are a faction's offices filled by election (T3-173)?
Is someone put in charge inside the room (T3-101), or is it disputed who speaks for the room to others (T3-126)?
Is a leader named for the work (T3-101), or the order's standing rules set (T3-172)?
Is one member put in charge (T3-101), or does the leader hand the work to all (T3-187)?

varies: From a demand for somebody clearly in charge to a faction appointing ministers and overseers.
two_or_half: It could be half of T3-173, offices in a room; kept apart because most leaders here are named for the work with no vote.

exemplars.quote: WE NEED A NEW THREAD WITH SOMEBODY CLEARLY IN CHARGE.

name: dividing the picture among teams
old_label: assigning teams to parts of the picture
gloss: The work is divided: teams, colours, rows or areas of the picture assigned to members.
must_show: Parts of the work assigned: teams for areas, colours or rows; 'one team fixes, another expands'; members asking to be given a job.
must_not_show: One template for all with no division (T3-091); shifts by hour of the day (T3-141).
decide_when_both: Teams by part and shifts by hour in one theme: the larger part primary, the other under rule 0.

discriminators.question: Is the work divided by part of the picture (T3-103), or by hours of the day (T3-141)?
Are directions given to all (T3-070), or parts handed to particular members (T3-103)?
Is everyone held to one plan (T3-091), or the plan cut into assigned parts (T3-103)?

varies: From a member asking to be assigned a job to colour armies and an icon split into 5x5 areas.
is_not: Handing the defence to another time zone overnight (T3-141).
two_or_half: It could be half of T3-141, dividing the labour; kept apart because the division is in space, not in time.

exemplars.quote: We need to make teams. One will fix trolling pixels. Another team to work on accuracy
Team Field - We will take care of the blue field.
We'll need 4 armies: 1 grey, 2 red, and one white.

name: saying the room wings it
old_label: saying the room just wings it
gloss: Members say the room has no plan or group: it goes with the flow, individuals placing on their own.
must_show: Statements that the room has no plan, organiser or group: 'we just wing it', 'go with the flow', 'no common group, all individuals'.
must_not_show: Complaints that the calls are scattered (T3-049); separating the room's plan from placers it does not control (T3-188).
decide_when_both: A room saying it has no plan and complaining of it: T3-125 when the lack is accepted, T3-049 when it is complained of.

discriminators.question: Is the lack of a plan complained of (T3-049), or stated as the room's way (T3-125)?
Do members say they have no plan (T3-125), or set their plan apart from placers they do not control (T3-188)?

varies: From a cheerful 'we don't do organize' to a member who cannot find where any coordination happens.
is_not: A room drawing the line between its coordinated members and placers it does not control (T3-188).
two_or_half: It could be half of T3-049, a room without a plan; kept apart because the room states it rather than complains of it.

exemplars.quote: Yeah definitely we don't do organize, just go with the flow.
not so far, just winging it.
Unfortunately, there's no like common group doing this; it's all individuals of the bi community

name: covering the night shift
gloss: Members keep the work through the night and across time zones: night watches, the work handed to another continent while they sleep.
must_show: Watch kept over the hours when most members sleep: night watches, members volunteering to stay up, the work handed to members in other time zones, scripts left running overnight for the purpose.
must_not_show: Defence or repair with no word on hours or sleep (T3-005, T3-021); the picture divided into parts (T3-103).
decide_when_both: Keeping watch and repairing: T3-021 primary, T3-141 added when the hours and shifts have concepts of their own.

discriminators.question: Is the work watched and repaired (T3-021), or watched through the hours others sleep (T3-141)?
Is the work divided by hour (T3-141), or by part of the picture (T3-103)?
Is an attack fought off (T3-005), or the night covered (T3-141)?
Do members place together at one time (T3-167), or take turns across the hours (T3-141)?

varies: From one member going to bed and hoping others hold to a German night shift over American pixels.
is_not: A member repairing the work during the day (T3-021).
two_or_half: It is half of T3-021 in substance, keeping the work; kept apart because the shift across hours and time zones is its own arrangement, and 31 rule 0 lines show it standing beside T3-021.

exemplars.quote: Europe, America's going to sleep. Hold the position!
Texan living abroad. Defending it will you sleep.
Wenn wir schlafen gehen und die Amis wach sind kann vieles passieren. Ich sollte Nachtwache schieben.

name: timing a mass placement together
gloss: Members set a time to place together so that many pixels land at once.
must_show: A time fixed or proposed for members to place together: a start time so that a few are not overrun, a scheduled push, a jointly timed ending.
must_not_show: Calls to place with no time set (T3-002); watches across the night (T3-141).
decide_when_both: A call with a time: T3-167 when the time is the point, T3-002 otherwise.

discriminators.question: Is a time set for placing together (T3-167), or hands called with no time (T3-002)?
Do members place together at one time (T3-167), or take turns across the hours (T3-141)?

varies: From a proposed start time for two placers to a faction's jointly timed white ending.
is_not: Handing the watch to another time zone (T3-141).
two_or_half: It is half of T3-002 in form, a call; kept apart because synchronising the placing is its own move.
